Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp number :=0;
 NEW_ID VARCHAR(10);
 v_addr_flag char(1);
 v_address varchar2(300);
begin
 nullchk; check_package_failure; 
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO TEMP FROM SPONSORS
 WHERE SPONSOR_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 --MS. Checking international address flag
 select nvl(a.intl_addr_flag, 'N')
 into v_addr_flag
 from sponsors s,
 addresses a
 where 1 = 1
 and s.sponsor_id = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID 
 and s.address_id = a.address_id;
 --MS

 IF TEMP <= 0 THEN
 show_error('11047'); 
 check_package_failure; 
 ELSE
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_chklst',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_pref',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --set_item_property('sponsors.pb_graph',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.PB_ABO',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.PB_DRIVE_DETAILS',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 if v_addr_flag = 'N' then
 SELECT A.NAME,B.address_1||' '||
 b.street_name||' '||B.address_2||' '||
 c.city ||', '||c.state||' '|| c.zip,
 b.d_area_code||decode(b.d_area_code,null,'','-') ||substr(b.d_phone_no,1,3)||
 decode(b.d_phone_no,null,'','-')||substr(b.d_phone_no,4,7)
 INTO :CTRL_BLOCK_1.NAME,:CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_address,:CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_phone
 FROM SPONSORS A, ADDRESSES B, valid_city_state c
 WHERE A.SPONSOR_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID 
 and A.address_id = B.address_id 
 and b.usps_id = c.usps_id; 

 --MS. Show international address if the flag is 'Y'
 elsif v_addr_flag = 'Y' then
 select s.name,
 (a.intl_address_1 || ', '||a.intl_address_2 || ', '|| a.intl_address_3 || ', '|| a.intl_address_4) || decode(a.country_name, null, '', ', ' || a.country_name)||' '|| a.intl_postal_code addr,
 a.intl_home_phone_no
 into :CTRL_BLOCK_1.NAME, 
 v_address, --:CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_address, 
 :CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_phone
 from sponsors s,
 addresses a
 where 1 = 1
 and s.sponsor_id = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID 
 and s.address_id = a.address_id
 and a.intl_addr_flag = 'Y';

 if v_address is not null then
 select CASE
 when instr(v_address, ', , , , ') != 0 then replace(v_address, ', , , , ', ', ')
 when instr(v_address, ', , , ') != 0 then replace(v_address, ', , , ', ', ')
 when instr(v_address, ', , ') != 0 then replace(v_address, ', , ', ', ')
 ELSE
 v_address
 END
 into :CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_address
 from dual;
 end if;
 end if;
 --MS

 END IF;

exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 CURSOR c1cur IS 
 SELECT ds.drive_id,d.drive_date
 FROM DRIVE_SPONSORS ds,DRIVES d
 WHERE ds.drive_id = d.drive_id 
 AND sponsor_id = :ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id 
 AND d.status = 'CNFRM'
 AND d.drive_date between (trunc(sysdate) - 540) and trunc(sysdate)
 ORDER BY 2 desc;
 runcount number := 0;
 totalcount number := 0;
 i number; -- for last three drives
BEGIN
 begin
 select description into :sponsors.lob_desc from 
 valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'LOB' and code = :sponsors.lob AND
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

 begin
 select description into :sponsors.cat_desc from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'SPCAT' and code = :sponsors.category
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

 begin
 select territory_short_name into :sponsors.territory_name 
 from valid_territories
 where territory_id = :sponsors.territory_id AND
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) AND
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;


 begin
 if :sponsors.sponsor_rating is not null then
 select description into :sponsors.rating from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'SPRAT' and code = :sponsors.sponsor_rating;
 else
 :sponsors.rating := 'Very Good';
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :sponsors.rating := 'Very Good';
 end;


 begin
 if :sponsors.default_location_id is not null then
 select location_name into :sponsors.location from locations
 where location_id = :sponsors.default_location_id;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;


 begin
 if :sponsors.parent_sponsor_id is not null then
 select name into :sponsors.parent_sponsor_name from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = :sponsors.parent_sponsor_id ;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
-- old method of showing penetration 
/*
 select count (distinct donor_id) into :sponsors.penetration
 from donations d, drive_sponsors s
 where d.drive_id = s.drive_id and
 s.sponsor_id = :ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id;
*/
-- new method of showing penetration in %age
 i := 0;
 FOR c1 IN c1cur LOOP
 select count (distinct donor_id) into runcount
 from donations d
 where d.drive_id = c1.drive_id ;
 i := i +1;
 totalcount := totalcount + runcount; 
 if i = 3 then
 exit;
 end if;
 END LOOP; /* for penetration */
 if :sponsors.employee_base is null or
 :sponsors.employee_base = 0 then
 :sponsors.penetration := '0.00 %';
 else
 :sponsors.penetration := substr(to_char(totalcount*100/:sponsors.employee_base),1,5)||' %';
 end if; 
END;

Block.Name: DRIVE_SPONSORS
Block.WhereClause:
drive_id IN (select a.drive_id from drives a, drive_sponsors b where
a.drive_id = b.drive_id and
b.sponsor_id = :ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id and
 a.status = 
DECODE(:ctrl_block_1.type,'R','CNFRM',:ctrl_block_1.type)
AND
 (drive_date between nvl(:ctrl_block_1.from,drive_date) and 
 nvl(:ctrl_block_1.to,drive_date) ) 
 )

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

PROCEDURE calc_totals IS
BEGIN
 if :ctrl_block_1.from is not null then

 select sum(nvl(a.projected_show ,0)),sum(nvl(a.projected_draw,0))
 into :ctrl_block_1.tot_pshow,:ctrl_block_1.tot_pdraw
 from drives b,drive_sponsors a
 where a.sponsor_id=:ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id
 and b.drive_id =a.drive_id
 and drive_date between :ctrl_block_1.from and :ctrl_block_1.to;

 select nvl(sum(nvl(credit_count,1)),0)
 into :ctrl_block_1.tot_acredit
 from donations
 where drive_id in (select b.drive_id
 from drives b,drive_sponsors a
 where a.sponsor_id=:ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id
 and b.drive_id =a.drive_id
 and drive_date between :ctrl_block_1.from and :ctrl_block_1.to)
 and deferral_id is null;
 
 select count(unit_id)
 into :ctrl_block_1.tot_adraw
 from donations
 where drive_id in (select b.drive_id
 from drives b,drive_sponsors a
 where a.sponsor_id=:ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id
 and b.drive_id =a.drive_id
 and drive_date between :ctrl_block_1.from and :ctrl_block_1.to)
 and deferral_id is null;

 select nvl(sum(nvl(credit_count,1)),0)
 into :ctrl_block_1.tot_def_count
 from donations
 where drive_id in (select b.drive_id
 from drives b,drive_sponsors a
 where a.sponsor_id=:ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id
 and b.drive_id =a.drive_id
 and drive_date between :ctrl_block_1.from and :ctrl_block_1.to)
 and deferral_id is not null;

 select nvl(sum(nvl(credit_count,1)),0)
 into :ctrl_block_1.other_credits
 from donations
 where coll_date between :ctrl_block_1.from and :ctrl_block_1.to
 and credit_sponsor = :ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id;

 select count(unit_id)
 into :ctrl_block_1.other_draws
 from donations
 where coll_date between :ctrl_block_1.from and :ctrl_block_1.to
 and credit_sponsor = :ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id;

 else

 select sum(nvl(a.projected_show ,0)),sum(nvl(a.projected_draw,0))
 into :ctrl_block_1.tot_pshow,:ctrl_block_1.tot_pdraw
 from drive_sponsors a
 where a.sponsor_id=:ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id;
 
 select nvl(sum(nvl(credit_count,1)),0)
 into :ctrl_block_1.tot_acredit
 from donations
 where drive_id in (select a.drive_id
 from drive_sponsors a
 where a.sponsor_id=:ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id )
 and deferral_id is null;
 
 select count(unit_id)
 into :ctrl_block_1.tot_adraw
 from donations
 where drive_id in (select a.drive_id
 from drive_sponsors a
 where a.sponsor_id=:ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id )
 and deferral_id is null;

 select nvl(sum(nvl(credit_count,1)),0)
 into :ctrl_block_1.tot_def_count
 from donations
 where drive_id in (select a.drive_id
 from drives b,drive_sponsors a
 where a.sponsor_id=:ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id )
 and deferral_id is not null;

 select nvl(sum(nvl(credit_count,1)),0)
 into :ctrl_block_1.other_credits
 from donations
 where credit_sponsor = :ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id;

 select count(unit_id)
 into :ctrl_block_1.other_draws
 from donations
 where credit_sponsor = :ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id;


 end if;

 :ctrl_block_1.tot_acredit := :ctrl_block_1.tot_acredit +:ctrl_block_1.other_credits;
 :ctrl_block_1.tot_adraw := :ctrl_block_1.tot_adraw +:ctrl_block_1.other_draws;
 END;

 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776', '9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF;
 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
